title: US freelancer get-paid & tax-ready system
core_problem: No withholding, quarterly estimated taxes and Schedule C categories are confusing; generic templates break or don't match the tax regime.
desired_outcome: Invoice, track income/expenses, and know what to set aside for taxes without panic at year-end.
related_problems: don't know how much to set aside for quarterly taxes
spreadsheet formulas break when I edit them
expense categories don't map to Schedule C

problems.statement: Freelancers already pay for tax/bookkeeping spreadsheets.
symptoms: RunTheCalc '1099 Self-Employed Bookkeeping Spreadsheet': 2.2k sales, 4.7-4.8★, priced ~$17.
PrioriDigitalStudio (sells a self-employed tax tracker): shop 173.8k sales, 11.1k reviews, 4.8★.

problems.statement: Generic templates lose to regime/trade-specific ones.
symptoms: Region/profession-specific trackers ('Self Assessment UK / HMRC', 'Therapist Bookkeeping') rank among bestsellers — specificity outsells generic.

problems.statement: Templates break or mis-fit; buyers want robust-but-simple.
symptoms: Buyers repeatedly report bookkeeping templates are 'too simple or too complicated' and spend time 'fixing broken formulas'.

problems.statement: Getting paid + tax admin is a recurring freelancer pain.
symptoms: Job seekers/contractors discuss estimated-tax and getting-paid friction; Stripe publishes a dedicated freelancer billing guide.

solution_gaps: robust-but-not-overwhelming middle ground (templates are too simple OR too complex)
formulas that don't break on edit
creator_ecosystem: unknown — no creator-density data collected this session
digital_product_fit: Strong: spreadsheet/calculator + short setup guide. Buyer earns money so a $10-25 tool is trivial.

demand_evidence.rationale: 1,000+ live listings + dedicated sub-category; recurring across sources.

pain_importance.rationale: Tax penalties + cashflow; high-stakes, recurring annually/quarterly.

clear_outcome.rationale: 'Know what to set aside / get paid on time' is concrete.

existing_wtp.rationale: RunTheCalc 2.2k sales at ~$17; premium over $1 generics.

solution_gap.rationale: Bestsellers are generic; correctness+niche gap is real.
